smart_port.description: Enter the same username/password you use in the mySigen app, plus your station ID and region. Find your station ID in the mySigen app URL or by asking your installer.

data.profile_refresh_days: Refresh full Energy Profile list every (days)

ac_charger.title: Connect your AC Charger to Sigen Cloud
ac_charger.description: Enter the same username/password you use in the mySigen app, your station ID, region, and the charger's serial number (shown on the charger screen in the app, e.g. under Device Info). If this integration already has a Smart Port entry for the same station, you can leave username and password blank to reuse its credentials.

data.base_url: API base URL (only used if Region = Custom)
data.profile_refresh_days: Refresh full Energy Profile list every (days)

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't log in or read status. Double-check your username, password, station ID, region, and (for chargers) the serial number.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.

settings.title: Sigenergy Cloud Control options
settings.description: How often Home Assistant polls the Sigen cloud for this device's real state. Lower values catch changes faster but log in more often - the default of 300s (5 minutes) is a sensible balance.

data.base_url: API base URL (only used if Region = Custom)
data.profile_refresh_days: Refresh full Energy Profile list every (days)

price_spike.title: Price Spike Export
price_spike.description: Discharge the battery while a price entity from another integration (for example AEMO NEM, Amber, Nord Pool, ENTSO-E, EPEX Spot, Tibber or Octopus) is at or above a threshold. Off by default. When it's turned on, its switches and settings appear on the Sigen Station device, where the threshold, timings, power and minimum SOC can be changed at any time. The threshold uses the price entity's own unit and currency.

data_description.price_spike_price_entity: A numeric price sensor, such as a wholesale or spot price. An input_number helper also works, for testing.
data_description.price_spike_price_unit: Shown next to the threshold, for example $/kWh or EUR/MWh. Only used if the price entity doesn't report a unit itself. It's just a label: the threshold is always compared with the entity's value as it is.
data_description.price_spike_soc_entity: Your battery's state of charge in %, for example from a local Modbus integration. The Sigenergy cloud API used here doesn't provide it.
data_description.price_spike_notify_action: For example notify.mobile_app_your_phone. Called when discharging starts and stops. Leave blank to only fire the events sigen_smartport_price_spike_export_started and sigen_smartport_price_spike_export_stopped.

off_grid.title: Off-Grid Control
off_grid.description: Adds a Grid Mode select to the Sigen Station device that disconnects your home from the grid (Off-Grid) and reconnects it (On-Grid), like the off-grid switch in the mySigen app. Needs a Sigen Gateway. Off by default. While off-grid, your home runs only on solar and battery: if the battery runs low, your home can lose power until it is reconnected. The Grid Connection sensor, which shows the actual state, is created either way.

error.price_entity_required: Choose a price entity to turn Price Spike Export on.
error.soc_entity_required: Choose a battery SOC entity to turn Price Spike Export on.
error.invalid_notify_action: No such action. Use the form notify.your_notifier, as listed in Developer Tools > Actions.

start_manual_control.name: Start manual control
start_manual_control.description: Starts Sigenergy Instant Manual Control on a Sigen Station for a set time. When the time is up, the station goes back to its Energy Profile.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to run, in minutes (1-1440). Defaults to 30.

power_limit.name: Power limit
power_limit.description: Maximum charge or discharge power in kW. Only used for Charging and Discharging. Leave empty or set 0 for no limit.

replace_running.name: Replace running manual control
replace_running.description: If manual control is already running, stop it and start this one instead. When off (the default), the action fails while manual control is running.

stop_manual_control.name: Stop manual control
stop_manual_control.description: Ends Sigenergy Instant Manual Control now. The station goes back to its Energy Profile.
